blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — In a span of less than a week, another alleged big-time drug peddler in Lanao del Sur was arrested, yielding P3.6 million worth of suspected shabu during a buy-bust operation in Taraka town on Thursday, police said. In a statement, Brig. Gen. Christopher Abecia, Director for Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), said they arrested Faiz Moin Tampogao, alias Jam, 33, unemployed and a resident of Barangay Dilausan, Maguing, Lanao del Sur, during the buy-bust operation. He was the third high-value target arrested in Lanao del Sur since Oct. 10. READ: Cops arrest 2, seize P3.9M in meth […]...
